nodes.text: Let $k\geq 0$. Let $G$ be a graph such that every subgraph $H$ contains an independent set of size $\geq (n-k)/2$, where $n$ is the number of vertices of $H$. Must $G$ have chromatic number at most $k+2$?

#922 : [ErHa67b] [Er69b] graph theory | chromatic number A question of Erdős and Hajnal [ErHa67b] . The case $k=0$ is trivial, but they could not prove this even for $k=1$. This is true, and was proved by Folkman [Fo70b] . See also [73] .
